senses.gloss: f. (= שיחתא; שְׁחַת; Assyr. šûtu, Del. Assyr. Handw., p. 648) [destruction,] shutha, a severe south wind; [Ar.: east wind].
units: Sabb. 32ᵃ ביומא דש׳ on a day when the shutha blew.
Yeb. 72ᵃ יומא דעיבא ויימא דש׳ וכ׳ on a cloudy day and on a shutha day we do not perform circumcision &c.
